Overview

What Is WARDOGS Game?

A concise overview page for explaining what WARDOGS is, who it is for, and where new players should start.

Target keyword
what is wardogs game
Priority
P1
Manual review
low

Quick Answer

WARDOGS is a tactical all-out-warfare FPS developed by BULKHEAD and published by Team17. Official sources describe large-scale multiplayer for up to 100 players across three teams, with infantry combat, vehicles, aircraft, building, destruction, logistics, and objective control.

The game is planned for Steam Early Access on September 10, 2026. As of August 28, 2026, official pages point to Steam / Windows PC as the confirmed launch platform.

WARDOGS is not confirmed as free to play. Steam lists a paid base purchase and a Supporter Edition, while official text says Early Access monetization is limited to the optional Supporter Edition.

Who Makes WARDOGS?

  • Officially confirmed:Steam lists BULKHEAD as the developer and Team17 as the publisher.
  • Officially confirmed:Team17's official WARDOGS page also presents WARDOGS as a BULKHEAD title published by Team17.

What Kind of Game Is It?

  • Officially confirmed:Official Steam and Team17 copy describe WARDOGS as a tactical all-out-warfare FPS.
  • Officially confirmed:The game features combined-arms combat, building, destruction, vehicles, logistics, support play, online multiplayer, and proximity voice chat.

How Big Are Matches?

  • Officially confirmed:Official sources describe up to 100 players across three teams.
  • Officially confirmed:The developer FAQ names the three factions as Valkyra, Lonestar, and Manticore.

What Makes It Different?

  • Officially confirmed:The main mode uses a randomly located 2 km by 2 km Control Zone inside a larger 256 km² environment.
  • Officially confirmed:Official descriptions emphasize three-team objective control, player-driven loadouts through cash, logistics, fortification, vehicles, and flyable aircraft.
  • General guidance:This guide avoids hype comparisons and focuses on what official sources confirm about WARDOGS itself.

Is WARDOGS Free to Play?

  • Officially confirmed:Steam lists WARDOGS as a paid pre-purchase before Early Access, with a base version and a Supporter Edition.
  • Officially confirmed:Official Supporter Pack text says there will be no WARDOGS monetization during Early Access except the optional Supporter Edition.
  • Not officially confirmed:No official source checked here describes WARDOGS as free to play.

What Platforms Is It On?

  • Officially confirmed:Steam and Team17 sources list Steam / Windows PC for the Early Access launch.
  • Not officially confirmed:No PlayStation, Xbox, or other console release date was found in the official sources checked on August 28, 2026.
  • Officially confirmed:The developer FAQ says future platform availability will be considered, but the current focus is PC.

Early Access Status

  • Officially confirmed:Steam lists the WARDOGS Early Access release date as September 10, 2026.
  • Officially confirmed:Steam's Early Access text says the game is expected to remain in Early Access for around 1 to 2 years, depending on development and community feedback.
  • Not officially confirmed:A full version 1.0 release date has not been officially announced.
